intro: Beverly Grove is one of LA's most restaurant-dense neighborhoods, centered on West 3rd Street and Beverly Boulevard between La Cienega and Fairfax. It's an easy place to walk from coffee to lunch to a long dinner, with the Beverly Center at its west end.
